`analyzeLandscape` is added as a second name for `updateLandscape`, and the CLI module's tests pass (`mvn -o -pl cli test`). I did not run the built jar to check the help output: running `java -jar` was blocked for approval in this session. The help text is covered by reading the code only.

What changed, both in `cli/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/cli/`:

- **`Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE = "analyzeLandscape"` with a description saying it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. It is listed in the no-argument usage overview with the same landscape options.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: both names dispatch to the same `updateLandscape` method. The method now takes the command name and description as parameters, so `-help` prints the usage under the name the user typed. Behaviour and options are otherwise unchanged, so `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` writes the same config and report as `updateLandscape`.
